summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Handoff: keep SearchWoot private and external outreach unsent. Woot documentation establishes API access mechanics, not public or commercial reuse rights; all four launch-readiness tasks remain open. Continue the consolidated rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, retention, and incident evidence bundle pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private and keep external outreach unsent. Evidence: source documentation establishes API access mechanics but not rights to store, transform, cache, display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use images/trademarks/prices, or monetize returned data; current public terms point against the proposed use. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is configured for 39 sites, but permission errors remain; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission, with no site-attributed commission; ROI, margin, and causal lift remain unknown. Security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. No task is closable because current artifacts are partial. Open tasks are source rights; alert-data flow and retention; GA4 consent/configuration; and logs, vendors, and incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, change the private gate, enable tracking, or expand monetization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = counsel_required and launch-blocked; missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, permitted caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Fleet compliance and claims triage: preserve consent and withdrawal behavior, cookie and analytics disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, data provenance and rights, copyright/trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards where applicable. Do not infer adult or regulated status from domain names. Compliance failures and unknowns require site-specific remediation or evidence; they do not automatically block ordinary reversible growth when existing disclosures, consent, data handling, and claims boundaries are preserved. Private or gated properties require an explicit keep-private decision and completed checklist before exposure.

Retain containment-only execution. Continue only existing failure repair-or-close, period-aligned measurement and attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence. Do not create proposals, requeues, experiments, duplicate telemetry, dependencies, spend, monetization expansion, deployments, or external outreach. Preserve the deferred SEO, UX, accessibility, performance, content, affiliate, attribution, and repository backlog.
